evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-700a ARC-108 sec-7 C3 SIGNED-vs-UNSIGNED-RPE ABLATION FALSIFIER (V3-EXQ-700 SIBLING, NOT a supersede; experiment_purpose=evidence; claim_ids=[MECH-439, ARC-108, MECH-450]). The deferred C3 of V3-EXQ-700, now runnable via the just-landed E3Config.learned_channel_rpe_mode flag (ree-v3 55742c1). Does the SIGNED dopaminergic-RPE delta_t = R_t - V-hat_t carry the committed-action-class conversion, or is it a precision re-weighting any unsigned magnitude would produce (divergence B5)? 4 arms over a MATCHED stack (the landed arithmetic envelope -- demotion + adaptive-floor + Go/No-Go + modulatory-authority/top_k shortlist + CRF -- a MATCHED CONSTANT on ALL arms, exactly as V3-EXQ-699/700): A0_ENVELOPE_ONLY (conversion baseline) / A1_SIGNED (use_learned_channel_gating, rpe_mode=signed default -- must convert) / C3_A1_UNSIGNED (A1 config + rpe_mode=unsigned, abs ARC-016 running_variance substituted for delta_t in BOTH w_chan and W_lat -- must FAIL to convert) / ARM_NOISE (verified-lifting matched-noise bar, 569g/684). PRIMARY DV = committed-action-class entropy; conversion = strict-above BOTH A0 AND the verified-lifting noise control by 0.05 on >=2/3 seeds. PASS supports = A1_SIGNED converts AND C3_A1_UNSIGNED does NOT -> the SIGN (directional credit) is load-bearing. If unsigned converts JUST AS WELL -> signed-RPE REFUTED, the mechanism collapses to precision re-weighting -> route back to ARC-016, do NOT mint a learning claim (weakens ARC-108/MECH-450; MECH-439 still supports -- the ceiling is liftable). C3-SPECIFIC non-vacuity self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue if the UNSIGNED arm's OWN learning signal (abs running_variance, emitted as lcg_delta_t) is flat OR its w_chan never moves (a no-conversion there would be vacuous, not a falsification); plus all the GAP-A guards (pool divergent / signed delta_t flat / signed weights never move / noise control not lifting). MECH-450 (W_lat settling, OFF on all arms here) is borne-on via the SHARED signed-RPE teaching signal the rpe_mode flag substitutes identically in the W_lat update. PROMOTES NOTHING (MECH-439 substrate_ceiling; ARC-108/MECH-450 substrate_conditional -> promote/demote suppressed). outcome=FAIL; label=substrate_not_ready_requeue; per_claim={'MECH-439': 'non_contributory', 'ARC-108': 'non_contributory', 'MECH-450': 'non_contributory'}.

result.c3_design_note: C3 (ARC-108 sec-7, divergence B5): does the SIGNED dopaminergic-RPE delta_t = R_t - V-hat_t carry the conversion, or is it just a precision re-weighting any unsigned magnitude would produce? The just-landed E3Config.learned_channel_rpe_mode flag (ree-v3 55742c1) substitutes abs(ARC-016 running_variance) for delta_t in BOTH the w_chan and W_lat three-factor updates under 'unsigned'. A1_SIGNED (default) must convert; C3_A1_UNSIGNED (A1 config + unsigned) must FAIL to convert. If the unsigned arm converts JUST AS WELL, the SIGN is not load-bearing -> route back to ARC-016 (precision re-weighting), do NOT mint a learning claim. The settling step (W_lat) is OFF on all arms here; MECH-450 is borne-on because the rpe_mode flag substitutes the SAME teaching signal in the W_lat update (a refutation undermines the shared JOB-1 learning basis for both ARC-108 and MECH-450).

interpretation_grid.PASS_signed_rpe_load_bearing_unsigned_fa: preconditions met (incl the C3-specific unsigned-arm non-vacuity: the unsigned learning signal carried variance AND its w_chan moved) AND A1_SIGNED converts (committed-class entropy strict-above BOTH A0 and the verified-lifting noise control on >=2/3 seeds) AND C3_A1_UNSIGNED does NOT converge. The SIGN (directional potentiate-vs-depress credit) is LOAD-BEARING; an unsigned precision magnitude alone cannot convert -> supports MECH-439 (ceiling liftable by signed-RPE learning) + ARC-108 (w_chan, directly) + MECH-450 (W_lat, via the SHARED teaching signal). PROMOTES NOTHING (substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional).
interpretation_grid.FAIL_signed_rpe_refuted_precision_reweig: preconditions met AND BOTH A1_SIGNED and C3_A1_UNSIGNED convert -- the unsigned ablation converts JUST AS WELL. The SIGN is NOT the load-bearing ingredient; the mechanism collapses to a precision re-weighting -> route back to ARC-016, do NOT mint a learning claim. MECH-439 supports (ceiling liftable) but ARC-108 / MECH-450 WEAKEN (not directional learning). This is a conclusive falsifier outcome.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_signed_arm_no_lift_escalate_v4_full: preconditions met BUT A1_SIGNED itself does not convert -> there is no conversion to ablate; the signed-vs-unsigned question is unassessable. genuine no-lift -> escalate to the V4 full BG-thalamo-cortical loop (design sec 6). NOT a falsification of ARC-107; non_contributory for all claims.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: a precondition is unmet: pool not divergent, OR the SIGNED arm's delta_t flat / weights never moved, OR -- the C3-specific guard -- the UNSIGNED arm's learning signal was flat OR its weights never moved (so a no-conversion there is vacuous, not a falsification), OR the matched-noise control did not lift above A0. The C3 question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification. Re-queue at an adequate substrate.
